title: stream: implement FusedStream for MPSC receiver wrappers
body:
## Motivation

`ReceiverStream` and `UnboundedReceiverStream` do not currently implement `futures_core::FusedStream`. Implementing it gives callers a reliable termination signal once the underlying MPSC receiver has permanently finished.

For bounded channels, closure and an empty queue are not sufficient to determine termination: outstanding permits may still send messages after `Receiver::close()`.

## Solution

Implement `FusedStream` for both wrappers:

- `ReceiverStream` records termination after `poll_next` returns `Poll::Ready(None)`.
- `UnboundedReceiverStream` records termination after `poll_next` returns `Poll::Ready(None)`.
- Subsequent polls after termination return `None` without polling the underlying receiver.

This preserves buffered messages and bounded-channel messages sent through outstanding permits.

Add lifecycle tests covering open channels, buffered messages after senders are dropped, bounded permits after close, termination after draining, and repeated polls after termination.
